Ὦ.shortDefinition: an omega; fig. to be last

ὠδίν.shortDefinition: a labor pain, birth pang; fig. a pang of anguish

ὠδίνω.shortDefinition: to be in labor, suffer birth pains; trad. to travail

Ωδουια.shortDefinition: Hodaviah, Hodiah; lit. Majesty of YH/Yah/Jah

Ωθηρι.shortDefinition: Hothir; lit. He Has Caused to Remain

ὠμία.shortDefinition: a shoulder region, side; fig. a projecting support

ὠμός.shortDefinition: to be raw; fig. to be cruel, brutal

ὠμότης.shortDefinition: a cruelty, brutality; lit. a rawness

Ωουδας.shortDefinition: Judah, Judas; lit. He Shall Be Praised

ὡραῖος.shortDefinition: to be in bloom, flourishing; fig. to be beautiful

ὡραιότης.shortDefinition: a bloom, prime; fig. a beauty

Ωρωνιν.shortDefinition: Beth Horon; lit. House of Hollowness

Ὡσαίας.shortDefinition: Jeshaiah, Osaias; lit. YH/Yah/Jah Has Saved

ὡσαννά.shortDefinition: save us!, salvation has come!; trad. hosanna!

ὡσεί.shortDefinition: as if, like; fig. about, approximately

ὥστε.shortDefinition: so as (to), so that; fig. therefore

ὠτότμητος.shortDefinition: to be crop-eared, with ears cut off

ὠφέλεια.shortDefinition: an advantage, usefulness; fig. a help, benefit

ὠφέλιμος.shortDefinition: to be profitable; fig. to be beneficial

ὤχρα.shortDefinition: a paleness, yellowing; fig. a mildew
